text: Before you connect any marketing tool to your assistant, ask what the assistant can do through that connection without you signing off. Ask where sign-offs actually happen, and whether the person who signs is the person who is logged in. Ask what the tool does when a web page or an AI answer contains text written to look like a command. Ask whether a standing permission could ever be read as permission to publish. Ask how you would cut off one assistant client while leaving the others connected.
